note: Nested agent spans on a subgrid waterfall (role=treegrid with arrow-key expand and collapse); drag the minimap to zoom the time window, which repositions every bar from the same start/duration records, and the critical-path toggle walks the latest-ending child chain. name: Rate Limit Monitor
note: A per-second traffic simulation for six API keys (demand clipped at each key's RPM, the excess becomes 429s) feeds one history buffer that drives a sub-pixel scrolling canvas, @property-animated conic TPM gauges, a sortable keys table and a 5-second rollup log; the rAF loop stops off screen and when the tab is hidden. Set --dbi-limits-h to 100dvh to run it full screen.

name: RAG Retrieval Lab
note: Drag the similarity cutoff across a two-series score histogram (role=slider, arrow keys step 0.01) and hit rate, MRR, precision, recall and context tokens are recomputed over all 24 graded queries at the chosen k; the chunk inspector greys out exactly the chunks the cutoff removes. Index switches go through a feature-detected View Transition, and --dbi-rag-h can be set to 100dvh for a full-screen tool.

name: GPU Fleet Heatmap
note: Each GPU cell carries a registered <number> (@property --dbi-gpu-u) that transitions between live readings, and its inferno-ramp background is derived from it with nested color-mix(), so colour fades smoothly with no JS animation; KPI counts tick through an <integer> property with counter(). A small scheduler moves queued jobs onto idle GPUs; the interval pauses off screen and in hidden tabs. Set --dbi-gpu-h to 100dvh for a full-screen ops view.
